rules: MVP first (user's priority): Nous v2 = (1) light scientific-method core, (2) hooks + validators for traceability and repro, (3) one Claude session. For every item choose the simplest version that meets acceptance; no extra options, layers, retries or abstractions; prefer deleting code; if a spec detail is heavy, implement the minimal form and log it in progress.txt as a later candidate.
Run Python as .venv/bin/python (3.11); tests with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`.
v2 tests must not need Go, BLIS or network: use fixture files and echo/python -c commands; test 3.9 regexes on plain strings. Only the human-run smoke and eval scripts use real BLIS.
docs/plans/ is gitignored: commit docs/plans/nous-v2/* with `git add -f`.
Push only to origin nous-v2-wip. Open/update draft PRs from nous-v2-wip into nous-v2 (the branch exists). Never push to main or nous-v2.

Per item: tests first (expect fail), implement, tests pass, /pr-review-toolkit:review-pr on the item diff, fix only valid findings (record each decision in progress.txt), pytest -q green, commit, push.

Human checkpoints (R4c, R10, R13): if the required human result file is missing, write BLOCKED.md saying exactly what the human must run, commit+push, and stop. Never poll or loop. The human deletes BLOCKED.md to resume.
The 15-minute progress reporter is run by the human outside the session; not a plan item.
Never enter plan mode or use any tool that asks an interactive question (EnterPlanMode, AskUserQuestion): this is an unattended background session. Plan in your reasoning or in a file.

Keep Nous lean (the user's explicit goal): add only what the SPEC requires; no extra abstractions, layers, config options, plugin points or 'future-proofing'; prefer one small module per concern and plain functions over class hierarchies; reuse existing helpers; delete dead code. Target for the whole v2 runtime (orchestrator/v2/, excluding schemas and tests): about 2,500 lines or less. If an item pushes past its share, simplify before marking it done, and record the line count in progress.txt.
